why: It is the only outfit with no blockers, and the only one that includes a bag, which the theatre evening requires. The satin wrap set with a clutch and gold repeat suits a 6–7 formality evening, and the coat comes off in the stalls. I accept on purpose the tonal, low-contrast scheme, the coat's several styling gestures (it stays buttoned for the walk), the two competing focuses (the set and the earrings), and the clutch's high price, since the clutch is a leather piece that can be worn with many outfits.
